title: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
abstract: arXiv:2610.13465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. translated_title: 当多模态大语言模型读不懂人类能读的文字：诊断并学习阅读“眯眼文字”
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可能无法读取嵌入在图像粗略结构中的文字（即人类通过眯眼就能辨认的文字），并错误地报告图像中不存在任何文字。我们将这类文字命名为“眯眼文字”，并将其作为一种识别缺陷加以研究，研究动机来自生产级内容审核流水线中的实际案例。我们构建了 SquintBench，包含 1076 张源自生产环境的审核图像，以及 SquintCtrl——一个用于机制诊断的受控合成测试集。冻结权重分析表明，隐藏的文字会留下粗略的信号，而字形身份的表征较弱；当提供正确的空间区域时，字形身份的可获取性会显著提高，这表明空间选择是主要瓶颈。在固定视觉 token 预算下，抑制高频内容也能提升阅读效果，同时视觉 token 的数量也可能产生影响。这些发现促使我们提出 Squint OPSD：一个冻结的教师模型接收缩小尺寸的视图和真实转录文本作为先验（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现多模态大模型存在“眯眼文字”识别缺陷，通过构建 SquintBench 与 SquintCtrl 两个基准诊断出空间选择是关键瓶颈，并据此提出 Squint OPSD 方法教会模型阅读此类隐藏文字。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "squint text" as a recognition deficiency in multimodal LLMs, introduces SquintBench and SquintCtrl benchmarks to diagnose spatial selection as the key bottleneck, and proposes Squint OPSD to teach models to read such hidden text.
